title: Ordinary-side evaluation of quotient section tensor normalization
statement: For normalized scalar section data c and an ordinary section tensor map e satisfying the scalar-unit pure-tensor formula, assume E preserves countable colimits. For every pair of internal complexes P,Q, the input identification followed by T.map(qTensor), the model counit on the section total, and Q.map of the signed total of e equals scalarTensorSectionPath. There is no K-flat or flat-term condition, internal derived tensorator b, or barB.

proof.text: Set EP and EQ to the termwise section images of P and Q, and g to mapBifunctorComparison e. Its existing map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX formula supplies the required equality on every tensor summand. This holds for all complexes and needs only the assumed countable-colimit preservation.

Apply section_tensor_total_scalar_square to g and its summand formula. This reuses the proved ordinary scalar-unit square and its signed totalization, with precisely the original hc and he hypotheses.

Apply section_tensor_total_localization_path to the preceding total square. Expand only the input and explicit path wrappers, the localized total comparison, and the identity termwise functor comparison. Rewrite sectionTotalComparison by sectionTotalComparison_eq and the total functor map on a pair by the native tensor map. Functoriality and associativity identify the resulting equation with the desired path equality.
